description: Canadian-built Harvard Mk III which served with the British Royal Navy Fleet Air Arm before transfer to Portugal in 1956, and was used in the Portuguese Colonial War. Displayed in the open plaza of the Fortaleza de Sao Miguel alongside armoured vehicles and artillery, described as well recovered and maintained. Confirmed present by a visitor account of a March 2025 visit.

Supplied to Portugal by France in 1961 and used in the Portuguese Colonial War. The second of the pair displayed in the open plaza of the Fortaleza de Sao Miguel, described as well recovered and maintained. Confirmed present by a visitor account of a March 2025 visit.
